states.name: q
states.meaning: Current counter value, constrained to 0 through 9 and encoded as a 4-bit unsigned integer.
states.update_time: posedge clk (after the edge has settled)

rules.condition: reset == 1 at posedge clk; q is assigned 0. Reset has priority over counting.
rules.spec_quote: reset input is active high synchronous, and should reset the counter to 0

rules.condition: reset == 0 at posedge clk; q is assigned (q + 1) mod 10, so 9 increments to 0.
rules.spec_quote: counts from 0 through 9, inclusive, with a period of 10

reset.name: reset
reset.first_released_cycle: first posedge clk with reset==0; q follows the count rule from 0 on that edge

mid: Inputs marked mid change after the posedge sample and before the next posedge; they affect the next sampled edge.
